runtime_blocker.reason: Party leadership selection currently permits a sole seated leader or eligible leader term to become an executive successor without filtering the textual role for executive candidacy. Importing DNC/RNC chair terms would therefore risk selecting a national committee chair as president.
required_before_term_ingestion: Represent national committee, House, Senate and national executive offices separately
Require role-aware executive candidacy when selecting presidential successors
Keep party administration avatars distinct from parliamentary negotiation roles and the elected president
Add regression tests that a DNC/RNC chair cannot be appointed president solely because of committee office

scope_note: Eight researched people only: six new identities and two enrichments. This does not complete USA party history, verify uncertain term boundaries, or create new cartoon art.
